sql.query: SELECT i.id instanceId,i.currentStepId,i.scenarioPackId,s.sequenceNumber FROM tbl_scenario_instances i INNER JOIN tbl_tenants t ON t.id=i.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_scenario_steps s ON s.id=i.currentStepId AND s.scenarioPackId=i.scenarioPackId WHERE i.tenantId=:tenantId AND i.status IN ('ready','active') AND t.isActive=1 AND t.tenantType='demo' AND t.lifecycleStatus='active' AND (t.accessStartDate IS NULL OR t.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (t.accessEndDate IS NULL OR t.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut WHERE ut.tenantId=i.tenantId AND ut.userId=:userId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active') ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 1

sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_scenario_executions (tenantId,scenarioInstanceId,scenarioStepId,idempotencyKey,executionStatus,attemptCount,claimedDate,executedDate,resultJson) VALUES (:tenantId,:instanceId,:stepId,CONCAT(:instanceId2,':',:stepId2),'completed',1,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,JSON_OBJECT('action','narrative_show')) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=LAST_INSERT_ID(id)

UPDATE tbl_scenario_instances i LEFT JOIN tbl_scenario_steps nextStep ON nextStep.scenarioPackId=i.scenarioPackId AND nextStep.sequenceNumber=:nextSequence AND nextStep.isActive=1 SET i.currentStepId=COALESCE(nextStep.id,i.currentStepId),i.status=CASE WHEN nextStep.id IS NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'active' END,i.startedDate=COALESCE(i.startedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),i.completedDate=CASE WHEN nextStep.id IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END,i.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE i.id=:instanceId AND i.tenantId=:tenantId AND i.currentStepId=:stepId

SELECT i.id instanceId,i.status instanceStatus,i.currentStepId,p.scenarioName,s.stepKey,s.sequenceNumber,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.configurationJson,'$.narrative')) narrative FROM tbl_scenario_instances i INNER JOIN tbl_scenario_packs p ON p.id=i.scenarioPackId INNER JOIN tbl_scenario_steps s ON s.id=i.currentStepId AND s.scenarioPackId=i.scenarioPackId WHERE i.id=:instanceId AND i.tenantId=:tenantId LIMIT 1
